What's new in ShawNotch 1.7.22

  • The equalizer beside the closed notch moves with your music, and rests when it's quiet. macOS asks once to let ShawNotch hear your music app; nothing is recorded. Settings → Now Playing → React to the sound.
  • Choose its look in Settings → Now Playing → Equalizer: Waves, Bars, an LED meter or a scrolling waveform.
  • Colours: the playback line, the equalizer, the volume bars and the Music Mode button can all take the cover's colours, or keep to the album's one colour.
  • A long artist line no longer runs under the Music Mode button.
  • Music Mode's poster no longer keeps the last song's cover in memory after it changes.
